body: Built contrib/archive (SE-07/08/21: Limits enforced while streaming, CleanKey on every name, symlink/hardlink/device/absolute/traversal/duplicate refused, nested archives count against MaxDepth, Inspect + DenyExecutables, Extract with rollback), contrib/crypt (SE-11/CP-02: chunked AES-256-GCM wrapper driver, per-object data key wrapped by Keyring, KMS interface + MemoryKMS, per-tenant via KeyIDFunc, index/object/storage-key/final bound, ranged reads decrypt only needed chunks, Rotate re-wraps only with CAS, keys redacted, conformance suite over it), scan/hashmatch.go (SE-14). Guides docs/plugins/archive.md, crypt.md, moderation section in docs/extending/write-a-scanner.md; examples/security-archive and security-crypt. Every guard break-verified. Open: examples/go.mod lines for the two modules (coordinator), per-tenant SSE-KMS on tenant S3 disks is adapters/s3 work (not in this package).
